mechanism: Voriconazole inhibits CYP3A4, increasing albendazole sulfoxide (active metabolite) levels, while albendazole may induce voriconazole metabolism, potentially reducing antifungal efficacy and increasing anthelmintic toxicity.
action: Monitor closely for albendazole toxicity; consider therapeutic drug monitoring of voriconazole levels; assess necessity of concurrent use and consider alternative anthelmintic if possible.
